summary: Axonex AI Group filed a 6-K furnishing an October 15, 2026 press release announcing that its majority-owned joint venture Rice Robotics (Hong Kong) Limited joined FLAIR's Embodied AI International Applications Hub and entered a collaboration agreement covering real-world training and validation of humanoid robots in education and manufacturing. The JV also launched TOMO, a wheel-based education humanoid. No securities, ownership stakes, prices, premiums, board recommendations, advisors, financing or regulatory clocks are disclosed. This is an ordinary business-development and product announcement, not a special situation; watch for commercial traction rather than deal terms.
